# Green Codex

Green Codex is an open Codex skill for Green IT, responsible digital engineering, accessibility,
web quality, and responsible AI.

## Scope

- Apply evidence-based eco-design guidance during coding and architecture work.
- Review code for energy, data, network, storage, performance, and lifecycle impact.
- Preserve accessibility and resilience while reducing unnecessary computation and transfer.
- Use RGESN, GR491, Opquast, and RGAA as source frameworks.
